review_type: independent corrected-template successor with disposable regressions
scope: Corrected round102 mutation/collector templates only; all retain deliberate ROUND102_* binding sentinels. The complete templates were not executed. Isolated source AST assertions, command arguments and the collector workflow function were tested using disposable repositories and in-memory API fixtures.
status: guard corrections supported; concrete publication bindings and execution approval pending

dispositions.change: Finalizer rejects direct newly-tracked/preserved-inventory collisions before merge and adds --no-overwrite-ignore. Before/after byte, mode and symlink checks remain.
dispositions.evidence: Regression cases1–4: inventory collision refuses; an ignored collision absent from the old inventory is protected by the merge flag; safe fast-forward preserves unrelated ignored content; prior unguarded argv reproduces overwrite only in the disposable control.

dispositions.change: Cleanup detaches, confirms no worktree advertises the branch, and deletes its ref using update-ref -d with the expected old OID. Branch configuration is intentionally retained. Remote explicit lease remains.
dispositions.evidence: Regression cases5–7: concurrently advanced branch is preserved by CAS refusal; exact expected branch is deleted with detached HEAD/config unchanged; another disposable worktree owning the branch triggers the source ownership assertion before deletion.

dispositions.change: Queue explicitly binds base ref main, expected topic branch and both repository names before its existing SHA/tree/review/preflight checks.
dispositions.evidence: Regression case8 evaluates the exact source assertion against intended and four wrong-ref/repository fixtures; wrong alternatives are rejected.

dispositions.change: Collector re-lists matching workflow/event/SHA runs and requires the selected latest ID and attempt to remain unchanged. It additionally checks the merge parent and queue-base ancestry.
dispositions.evidence: Regression case9 runs only the extracted workflow function with in-memory API responses: unchanged evidence passes, a newer matching run or incremented attempt fails freshness. Source inspection verifies ancestry and event/SHA predicates.

limitations: No real CMMMech Git refs, original-main files, remote repository or GitHub API were touched by the regressions. All Git mutations were confined to newly created disposable directories beneath the receipt root.

Template placeholders are intentional. Concrete head/tree/PR/preflight bindings, issue state expectations, source hashes and final acquisition evidence still need a separate pre-execution review after rebinding. This artifact is not permission to run unbound templates.
The finalizer still deliberately relies on coordinator semantic PASS assessment of hosted evidence before invocation; loading/hashing that file alone does not establish acceptance.

Worktree-ownership reads, workflow re-listing and live-main checks remain non-atomic observations. The expected-old-OID deletion protects against a changed local ref, but no guarantee against every concurrent worktree operation or later remote change is asserted.
Queue ancestry plus tree/event/SHA checks add evidence; the final concrete queue commit must still be linked to the actual PR/merge-group event in the hosted assessment.
Direct inventory intersection is additional evidence; the Git no-overwrite-ignore behavior is independently exercised for an ignored collision not present in the earlier inventory.
No entire publication helper was invoked, and no actual merge, queue admission, branch cleanup or original-main fast-forward is claimed.
